description:
China says homelessness doesn’t exist. So why are Chinese people making viral videos about how to survive on the streets?

The CCP may have found a simple solution to homelessness: change the definition. As China’s economy struggles, young people face unemployment and growing pessimism—and Beijing is rewriting the language around poverty, homelessness, and even human rights.
